name: Data.classAut_eq_bot_of_le_chosenLevel
summary: Neatness from `classAut_eq_bot`: the chosen places form an injective family whose norms multiply to gProd(D)^{f(D)}, and (2·#n)^{[E(D):ℚ]} ≤ ((4·n(D, m(D)))²)^{f(D)} < gProd(D)^{f(D)}.

steps.claim: Apply `classAut_eq_bot` to the family chosen(D), which is injective (first field of `isConjApart_chosen`): it gives classAut(stdRatPoints, K, g) = {1} for all g once (2·#n)^{[E(D):ℚ]} < ∏_x q(chosen(D)(x)) and K ≤ levelOf(chosen(D), ⊥) = chosenLevel.
steps.lean:
∀ g, classAut stdRatPoints K g = ⊥ := classAut_eq_bot D.isConjApart_chosen.1
  (by grw [prod_q_chosenPlace, h, finrank_eq_two_mul_card_infinitePlace,
  pow_mul]; gcongr; use D.nat_lt_of_hasLogBound) hK

steps.claim: The norm bound: ∏_x q(chosen(D)(x)) = gProd(D)^{f(D)} (`prod_q_chosenPlace`), #n ≤ 2·n(D, m(D)) (h) and [E(D):ℚ] = 2·f(D) (`finrank_eq_two_mul_card_infinitePlace`), so (2·#n)^{[E(D):ℚ]} ≤ ((2·2·n(D, m(D)))²)^{f(D)}, and it suffices that (4·n(D, m(D)))² < gProd(D), which `nat_lt_of_hasLogBound` proves (upper exponent 11·logX(D) + O(1) against the lower exponent 20·logB(D) of gProd(D)).
steps.lean:
(by grw [prod_q_chosenPlace, h, finrank_eq_two_mul_card_infinitePlace,
  pow_mul]; gcongr; use D.nat_lt_of_hasLogBound)
